layout.global: h-screen w-full flex items-center justify-center p-4 md:p-8 overflow-hidden
layout.app_shell: w-full max-w-7xl h-full max-h-[900px] rounded-3xl border border-zinc-800 shadow-2xl flex overflow-hidden backdrop-blur-3xl relative
layout.sidebar: w-20 border-r border-zinc-800 flex flex-col items-center py-8 gap-8 shrink-0 z-10
layout.main_content: flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-8 relative z-10 overflow-y-auto

Sidebar.instructions: Vertical flex container. Map through navigation items. Active state gets a subtle glowing background (e.g., bg-zinc-800 text-white) and rounded-xl. Inactive items are text-zinc-500 hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-800/50.

ChatComposer.instructions: Large rounded-2xl container (bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800). Flex column. Top area for input textarea (bg-transparent, no ring). Bottom area for 'Import file' (paperclip) and 'Tools' controls, plus a distinct 'Send' action button (e.g., bg-white text-black rounded-full p-2 hover:bg-zinc-200).

QuickActions.instructions: Bento-style grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4). Cards with hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform. Titles: 'Surprise me', 'Create image', 'Summarise'. Soft icons inside.

OrbAvatar.instructions: Centered glowing 3D orb using the provided image URL. w-24 h-24 rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-zinc-700/50 shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(255,255,255,0.05)].

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast against dark backgrounds meets APCA standards.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have visible focus states (e.g., focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-zinc-400).
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='chat-send-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the layout as a floating app shell on a dark background (bg-slate-950).
The sidebar should have an active state for the Home tab (data-testid='sidebar-home-active').
Center the OrbAvatar above the Greeting ('Good morning, Hendricks').
The Composer must have a 'Send' button, an 'Import file' button, and 'Tools' controls. Use the mock data provided.
Ensure all components are responsive, breaking down gracefully on smaller screens.
Use standard .jsx files for React components.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, and navigation links.
Apply Framer Motion or Tailwind transitions for hover states on the quick action cards (hover:-translate-y-1 shadow-lg).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in global CSS. Do not disrupt human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
